content:
Aztec Team Transfers All ETH from Public AZTEC Auction to Coinbase

Aztec sold 15% of its AZTEC tokens through a public auction last December, raising 19,388.4 ETH (~$59.13M) at roughly $0.0473 per token, now down around 50% from the sale price. At TGE, 4,234.6 ETH from the auction proceeds was allocated to build liquidity, while the remaining ~15,154 ETH has been fully transferred to Coinbase over the past three months, with the final transfer completed on April 17 at 16:44 UTC.
